UserAccount.title: UserAccount
UserAccount.description: Authenticated Google user profile for MessMind Venture Studio (owner-isolated PII).

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: User display name from Google Sign-In.

photoURL.description: Optional profile avatar URL from Google Sign-In.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when user profile was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest user sign-in update.

VentureStudioWorkspace.title: VentureStudioWorkspace
VentureStudioWorkspace.description: Per-user persisted MessMind Venture Studio workspace containing ventures, Stage 1 research, positioning map, positioning statement, and AI Strategy Challenge records.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the workspace owner.

selectedVentureId.description: Currently selected venture ID or empty string if none.

lastSavedAt.description: ISO timestamp string of latest studio edit.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when workspace document was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when workspace document was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-only authenticated user profile document containing Google Sign-In identity and email PII.

/users/{userId}/studio/{studioDocId}.description: Owner-only venture studio workspace subcollection document storing the user's ventures and Stage 1 progress.
